tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for your participation. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about your cooking habits. [2-second pause] First, what kind of meals are most common or popular where you live? For example, do people usually prefer traditional dishes, fast food, or other types?
(Interviewer) I see. If you were setting up your own kitchen, would you choose to buy modern tools and appliances, or just stick to the basics and have a few simple items? Why?
(Interviewer) Interesting. These days, many people order food online instead of cooking at home. What do you think are the advantages or disadvantages of this trend? Please explain your opinion.

(Interviewer) Good points. I just have one more question. Some people believe that cooking at home is healthier and better for you than eating out at restaurants. Do you agree with this idea? Explain why.
